Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : The Tenderer shall have
a) A minimum of 03 (three) years of general experience in the Supply of computers and related equipment for newly appointed
officers of Gazipur Development Authority (Years counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the Newspaper).
b) The minimum specific experience as supplier in supply of computers and related equipment at least 01 (One) contract
successfully complete within the last 05 (five) years with a value of at least TK. 7.00 (Seven ) Lac. (Years counting backward from
the date of publication of IFT in the Newspaper).
c) Specific experience of satisfactory completion of supply of computers and related equipment of similar nature and size as stated
under ITT substantiated by Completion Certificate (s) issued or duly certified by the relevant Procuring Entity(s).
d) The minimum supply and/or production capacity of Goods is/ are: minimum 50 nos computers and related equipment
e) The minimum amount of financial resources as liquid asset or working capital or credit line(s) or specific credit commitment or in
any combination of them, of the Tenderers shall be Tk 10 (ten) lac
f) Valid Trade License. ( up to date )
g) Valid VAT Certificate Valid TIN certificate . ( up to date )
h) Valid Income Tax Clearance Certificate (Most Recent Assessment Year) . ( up to date )
i) Delivery and Documents: As per TDS.
j) Any other document/terms & condition mentioned in TDS & PCC
All other required qualifications, special terms & conditions of the tender are shown in the ITT, GCC & Tender Data Sheet (TDS),
Tender Documents and upload sections (Section).
